capability_declaration.evidence: IEEE 2030.5-2018, Section 10 (Device Capability), Section 11 (End Device Control), and Annex D (Device Capability Model)
capability_declaration.rationale: The standard explicitly defines device capabilities and allows DERs to declare their functions, but lacks granularity for autonomous AI agent-specific declarations.

bounded_authority.evidence: IEEE 2030.5-2018, Section 8 (Security), Section 11 (End Device Control), and Section 12 (Demand Response)
bounded_authority.rationale: The standard defines limits on device control, authorization scopes, and revocation, but does not explicitly address AI-specific bounded authority.

decision_auditability.rationale: Logging and metering requirements are implied for decisions, but explicit auditability and attribution for AI agents are not detailed.

data_governance.rationale: Data ownership, consent, and retention are implicitly covered under security and privacy clauses, but lack explicit governance requirements.
